attribution_limitations: The melanoma "measured 6.8 mm" without naming the dimension, while the histology reports a Breslow thickness of 2.7 mm; the two numbers are printed for different or unspecified attributes.

The Figure 2B caption times the PET at "After 18 cycles of treatment" (counted from pembrolizumab treatment), while the text times the final clinical review "After 10 months of treatment with Apremilast and Pembrolizumab" and does not state a time for the PET and CT. The two times have different anchors and are not a value conflict.
The anchor of "15 days later" for methylprednisolone discontinuation is not stated (end of the 5-day course or start of therapy).

Pembrolizumab resumption after the 4-week interruption is not stated in the text; the 10-month statement quotes treatment with both drugs. The timeline image (Figure 3) prints dates and a resumption box, but values printed inside images are pixel content only and are not used as facts.
Discussion paragraphs describe other published patients (Salopek, Fattore, Sapalidis, Apalla, Nigro) and are not assigned to the index patient.
